text:
Ravi: Quick sync: we need a clear decision on MVP cuts today. Proposal: move Tenant Reporting and Role Admin to v1; keep SSO, onboarding, prompt-store, embeddings export, and a single "recall" search flow in MVP. Also proposing a "burnline" metric (expected cost/day) as a hard checkpoint. Thoughts?

Marta: Sounds reasonable. Pilot customers will expect reporting; suggest a lightweight "counts-only" tile instead of full reporting so pilots still see value.

Sanjay: Infra note: embeddings cache is the main schedule risk. Options:
- ship without cache (simplest)
- prefix-only cache (tenants only) ~2d eng + 1d SRE
- sampled rollout (50%) ~3w smaller team
If we keep cache, we must add a rollback flag.

Devin: I prefer prefix-only cache if it buys tail latency. Also agree on burnline: set default `mvp.burnline=$1000/day` that triggers alerts and autoscale gating.

June: UX note: counts-only tile + export status modal will prevent support tickets. I can wireframe and copy in 24h.

Marta: Timelines? If we pick no-cache we can keep GA date; with sampled rollout we may need a 2-week slip. Which do we prefer?

Ravi: Product preference: keep GA date. So default to no-cache or prefix-only if we can hit 2d estimate. Add contingency lane in milestone tracker and explicit rollback flag `mvp.runtime.embcache=false`.

Sanjay: I'll scope prefix-only cache to an MVP-safe subset (tenant prefixes only). If blocked, we fall back to no-cache and enable monitoring probes every 10m. Estimate final by EOD.

Devin: I'll draft the flag RFC and QA checklist (toggle without restart, metrics sanity, canary traffic). Add `mvp.latency-guard=400ms` P95 soft cap as an operational guard.

release-bot: Reminder: schedule `/freeze mvp-burnline` before Tue 09:00 to lock PRs.

Ravi: Action items: Ravi -> update cutboard + burnline; Marta -> confirm pilot tenants + counts tile acceptance; Sanjay -> prefix cache estimate or fallback plan; Devin -> flag RFC + QA steps; June -> UX mock + support blurb. Ping this thread when done. :eyes:
